# zusvg

zusvg renders SVG icons and logos to pixels: a `nativeRaster` for grid
and base graphics, an RGBA array, raw RGBA bytes, or a PNG or JPEG file.
It bundles two small C libraries,
[plutosvg](https://github.com/sammycage/plutosvg) and
[plutovg](https://github.com/sammycage/plutovg), so it installs from
source on every platform with no system library: no librsvg, no cairo,
no Rust toolchain. The same document gives the same pixels everywhere.

It is meant for icons and logos. It does not render text, filters,
masks, patterns, markers, CSS style sheets or clip paths; a document
that uses them renders without them, and text and clips warn. For plots,
diagrams and badges, which mostly need text, use
[rsvg](https://docs.ropensci.org/rsvg/).

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zusvg")
```

## Example

``` r

library(zusvg)

icon <- '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
  fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
  <path d="M3 10.5 12 3l9 7.5V20a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-5v-6H9v6H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1z"/></svg>'

r <- svg_render(icon, width = 64, color = "steelblue")   # a nativeRaster
plot.new(); rasterImage(r, 0, 0, 1, 1)

svg_png(icon, "house.png", width = 128)                   # a PNG file
a <- svg_render(icon, width = 64, as = "array")           # the shape rsvg's rsvg() returns
```

[`svg_load()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_load.md)
checks untrusted input under limits on size, element count, nesting and
embedded images before the renderer sees a byte;
[`svg_elements()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_elements.md)
and `svg_render(id = )` cut an icon sheet into icons; and `palette`
answers CSS [`var()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/cor.html) colours. See the
vignette,
[`vignette("zusvg")`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/articles/zusvg.md).

# Package index

## Loading

- [`svg_load()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_load.md)
  : Load an SVG document
- [`svg_read()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_read.md)
  : Read an SVG file
- [`svg_validate()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_validate.md)
  : Check that a document loads

## Rendering

- [`svg_render()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_render.md)
  : Render an SVG document
- [`svg_png()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_png.md)
  [`svg_jpeg()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_png.md)
  : Render an SVG document to PNG or JPEG

## Measuring

- [`svg_size()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_size.md)
  : Size of an SVG document
- [`svg_extents()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_extents.md)
  : Extents of a document or element
- [`svg_elements()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/svg_elements.md)
  : Elements of an SVG document

## Conditions and build information

- [`zusvg-conditions`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/zusvg-conditions.md)
  : Conditions raised by zusvg
- [`zusvg_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zusvg/reference/zusvg_info.md)
  : Build information
